PNN-001 Under investigation

Caught in their own Webb

Seven teams, seven names, one straggler. PNN asks why the Black Webb Bandits took the longest to pick a name that is three words and a second B.

Subject team
Black Webb Bandits
Opened
October 4, 2026 at 7:21 PM (America/Denver)
PNN threat rating
Temporarily contained. Webbing intact.

The incident

The Black Webb Bandits were the final team to submit their name. Rumors of cold feet circulated, all eight of them. The word 'chicken' was mentioned, and PNN would like the record to show it was mentioned by other people, in a tone of enormous enjoyment.

By then, other teams had already named themselves after fire, underwear, and an actual government cover-up. The Bandits arrived last, with a name that is a spider pun wearing a mask. PNN has opened a file to determine whether this was a failure of nerve or simply a failure to escape the panther.

Suspected motive

PNN theory: the Bandits spent the better part of a week hunting for a name with more than two puns in it, and settled for exactly two ('Webb' and 'Bandits'). It is the kind of math only a spider can do: eight legs, one idea.

The alternative theory is that a spider-themed team cannot announce anything while a panther is on patrol. Spiders are experts at waiting for something to walk into their plans. They have simply never been timed.

Investigator's note

The chicken connection remains unsupported. Clueso prefers the panther theory, mostly because the panther is the right color and he has been hoping for an excuse. He notes that a reconstruction featuring a panther is not, regrettably, evidence against the Prowling Purrpetrators. He has requested more facts and fewer obstacles to his conclusion.

— Inspector Clueso, PNN

Official PNN assessment

Name recovered. Alibi pending. The Black Webb Bandits are officially on the board; the reason for their late arrival remains under investigation. A word of advice: being last is only embarrassing if it becomes a pattern. (It becomes a pattern. See PNN-002.)

Catnip & Hairball ratings

  • Black Webb Bandits: 1 catnip, 3 hairballs. Last to submit a name. Eight legs, one deadline.
